posts.post:
most 'premium' brands are just charging a logo tax on mid-weight cotton.
we’re all tired of it.

some guys look better in a plain black tee than anyone else in a suit.
it’s all about the fabric weight.
first dates are when you find out if someone actually knows how to dress, or if they’re just wearing what they bought at the mall.

we scrapped our entire hoodie design because the pockets sat half an inch too low.
it felt wrong.
